_comment: Columns of the support matrix, in order. Entries with material_id take their temps from data/materials/<id>.json; the rest are support-only materials. chamber_optional = tolerates a chamber up to chamber_c[1] but does not need one.

support_materials.name: HIPS
support_materials.note: Breakaway for ABS/ASA; dissolves in limonene. Needs the same hot bed and chamber as ABS.

support_materials.name: PVA
support_materials.note: Water soluble. Degrades above ~250°C nozzle and softens in a hot chamber. Must be genuinely dry.

support_materials.name: BVOH
support_materials.note: Water soluble, takes higher bed and chamber temps than PVA, which is why it pairs with nylon. Must be genuinely dry.

support_materials.name: PA support
support_materials.note: Bambu Support for PA/PET or equivalent. Breakaway interface for nylon.

support_materials.name: PET support
support_materials.note: Bambu Support for PA/PET or equivalent. Breakaway interface for PET-CF.
